podcast.body: Released on May 21st, 2002, this was Tom DeLonge's side project, initially conceived to satisfy his desire to play dirtier, more aggressive punk while recovering from back surgery. It was not intended to be a real band. The album is a concept album that explored themes of the end of the world, conspiracies, religion, the apocalypse, and the Masons. It started acoustically but became louder and more electric during its creation. Produced by Jerry Finn, who also worked with Blink 182. "They released an album, a concept album, that dealt with the end of the world."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Rise and Fall and Rise of Blink 182 Part 2
